prompt_md: A road has a 75% chance of at least one accident in any hour, with accidents at random at a steady rate. What's the chance of at least one in any half hour?
prompt_short: 75% chance of an accident per hour. Chance per half hour?
hint_md: Think about the chance of a quiet hour.
explain_intuition_md: A quiet hour is two quiet half hours in a row. Quiet hours happen 25% of the time, so quiet half hours must happen 50% of the time, since half of a half is a quarter. That leaves a 50% chance of an accident.
